fee_notes: Royalty: greater of 6% of Net Billings or tiered minimum ($500 months 0–12, $1,000 months 13–24, $1,500 months 25–36, $2,000 months 37+). Brand Fund: 2% of Net Billings. Local Marketing Commitment: greater of $750/month or 1% of Net Billings (due monthly). Technology fee currently $200/month (webpage, 3 emails, phone, LMS) plus $30/month per additional email. Call Center fee not currently imposed. Additional fees: conference registration (currently $495), training ($750/day), transfer (50% of then-current initial fee), renewal (50% of then-current initial fee), audit, late fees, noncompliance ($250/incident), and various remediation/reimbursement fees.
